scope: Python and JavaScript/TypeScript Directus list-query extension parity through typed location readers

behavior.extension_parameters: Forwarded and serialized using existing Directus query conventions
behavior.scoped_filter: Typed location helper overwrites conflicting location filters
behavior.standard_options: Typed filter, sort, fields, limit, offset, page, and meta values cannot be overridden by extension parameters
behavior.authorization: No authorization or tenant-isolation claim; query scoping is a client convenience only

rollback: Revert the SDK, documentation, and regression-test changes; no migration or persisted data was changed.
